column1: # screen field batch 13: GameScreen wrap-up.
# gameMode (f) is the SessionMode the screen drives (instanceof checks against Tutorial/Campaign/
# Skirmish/Multiplayer throughout); tutorialHintBox (bI) is built only for TutorialGameMode and is
# the source of every notifyStepEvent()/getActionCode() call; fpsLabel (bx) is the debug label set to
# "FPS: " + Gdx.graphics.getFramesPerSecond().
# Input state: dragging (bU) is set while a map/selection drag is in progress and is what makes the
#   code ignore the <25px press distance test; domainCounts (bX) is one counter per Domain, filled
#   while scanning the units under the pointer so the dominant domain can win; dragDx/dragDy (ca/cb)
#   are the pointer delta converted to world units, normalised and applied as camera pan.
# zPixelScale (ax = round(64/sqrt(2))) converts world heights to pixels: unitType.getMoveFactor() * ax
#   for the unit footprint and volley/projectile z * ax for the altitude offset.
# The water sparkle scheduler: waterSparkleTimes/waterSparkleX/waterSparkleY (cm/cn/co) are parallel
#   arrays over a coarse grid (width*width/9); every second a cell picks a random all-water tile with
#   no site and no units, and the draw pass renders the 7-frame 16x16 animation at that tile.
# Left unnamed - all of them are dead in this build (declared, never read; verified by searching every
# occurrence): the constants b (25), c (0.2f), d (0.9f), w (1000000000L), L/M/N (0.5f/0.5f/1.0f),
# cl (1000000000L), av/aw (the 128/64 tile pixel sizes, hard-coded as literals at the call sites),
# aC ((short)16), ae (float), bJ (Integer.MIN_VALUE), bM (read as a "built 1s ago" flash window but
# never written), at/au (computed in layout() and never read), X (Long.MIN_VALUE), plus cd/ce/cf (the
# cached mouse/touch button states, whose three-way split cannot be told apart from the code) and
# cp..cs (javac switch maps).
